verdict.rationale: Meilisearch's own materials say it helps users find results "instantly" even from partial input, and it pairs with React InstantSearch for responsive interfaces. Hands-on reports call search fast (3x faster than Elasticsearch, "Searches are fast"). However, no evidence documents per-keystroke prefix matching or millisecond latency for text search, and one user measured about 360ms on a production deployment, which lowers confidence. Missing for 10: explicit docs on prefix/as-you-type search-on-every-keystroke behavior, documented millisecond latency figures for full-text queries, independent latency benchmarks confirming sub-100ms responses.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deliver as-you-type instant search with millisecond responses so results update on every keystroke

citations.quote: Help users find what they want instantly, even when they misspell or only remember part of it.
Build performant, responsive search interfaces by pairing Meilisearch with React InstantSearch.
